name: photo-delivery
description: Dedicated, minimal, read-only Vercel project serving AstroHub Contact profile photos from a private Cloudflare R2 bucket under photos.astronomicconnect.com. No upload/delete/listing route exists here -- see app/avatars/[filename]/route.ts. Deliberately separate from the main AstroHub frontend project so R2 read credentials and image-serving traffic never touch it.
